english.title: Contravene / fail to comply with local traffic order relating to parking spaces - outside greater London

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: New Road and Street Works Act 1991

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), contravened a provision made under **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER..) as to the use of a parking place situated at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION OF THE PARKING PLACE..) in that **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..)

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in the case of an offence committed by a person in a street parking place reserved for disabled persons' vehicles or in an off-street parking place reserved for such vehicles, where that person would not have been guilty of that offence if that motor vehicle in respect of which it was committed hand been a disabled person's vehicle.

A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale in any other case

Fixed penalty ticket - Thirty pounds. Now usually issued by a Local Authority NOT the Police.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months
